ayahs.1: Glorify the Name of your Rabb, the Most High,
ayahs.2: Who created and perfectly fashioned all things,
ayahs.3: Who measured precisely and guided accordingly,
ayahs.5: then reduces it to dry stubble.
ayahs.6: We will have you recite the Qur'an so you will not forget—
ayahs.7: except what Allah wills. He knows what is open and what is hidden.
ayahs.8: We will ease you onto the path of ease.
ayahs.9: So remind—even if the reminder benefits only some.
ayahs.10: Those in awe of Allah will take heed.
ayahs.11: The most wretched will avoid it,
ayahs.12: and burn in the greatest Fire,
ayahs.13: where they will neither live nor die.
ayahs.14: Successful are those who purify themselves,
ayahs.15: remember their Rabb's Name, and establish salah—the formal prayer.
ayahs.16: But you prefer the life of this dunya,
ayahs.17: even though the Akhirah—the everlasting life after death—is better and more lasting.
ayahs.18: This was written in the earlier Scriptures—
ayahs.19: the Scriptures of Ibrahim and Musa.
